polityNote: Somali Democratic Republic / Federal Republic of Somalia (de jure, including Somaliland). NE puts Somaliland in a separate adm0 (SOL), so its five regions are listed as unresolved units without atoms.

sources.title: Statoids — Regions of Somalia (Gwillim Law)
sources.says: ~1982 eight provinces became sixteen regions; 1984-06 Awdal split from Woqooyi Galbeed and Sool from Nugaal.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Administrative divisions of Somalia (rev 1369122785)
sources.says: Middle/Lower Juba, Gedo, Bay, Bakool created 1974–75; in June 1984 Awdal and Sool split off, forming the current 18 regions.

spans.dateNote: Span opens when the 18-region layout is attested (June 1984). The region itself is older (1974–75 per Mukhtar via Wikipedia, ~1982 per statoids); not claimed earlier. De jure through 2019 (the federal government still lists the 18 regions). Nugaal lost Sool in June 1984; before that its territory reaches into the NE Somaliland feature.

unresolved.what: Awdal region (1984-06 →): inside the single NE feature "Somaliland" (adm0 SOL), not in the SOM atom set
unresolved.why: Natural Earth gives the five north-western regions as one feature under a separate adm0 (SOL+00?), so no SOM atom carries them and the five cannot be separated.
unresolved.needs: geoBoundaries SOM ADM1 (18 regions; licence to check) or OCHA COD-AB Somalia
